verdict.rationale: Box documents OAuth 2.0 access tokens for API calls and for agents connecting through its hosted MCP server. Its docs also say agent access keeps Box and enterprise permissions intact, so an agent's credential is bounded by existing permissions. Nothing shows that you can issue a credential with explicitly narrowed scopes for an agent; the developer token example points to broad, user-level access. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or per-token permission restriction, agent-specific service accounts or app-level least-privilege configuration, token expiry/revocation controls, and independent corroboration.
